survivalassistant.welcome.1: Hello %s! I'm %s, an old explorer and your guide. I'll walk with you for as long as you need me and help you survive.
survivalassistant.welcome.2: Sneak and right-click me for a tip, or use /guide tip. Want some peace and quiet? /guide mute <minutes>.
survivalassistant.comfort.1: Ouch! Don't worry: your items stay at the spot where you died for 5 minutes. Go get them, carefully!
survivalassistant.comfort.2: That happens to everyone. Your items are still lying where you fell, for 5 minutes. Hurry, but stay safe.
survivalassistant.chat.unavailable: I seem to have lost my voice. Talk to me again in a minute!
survivalassistant.all_done: You've done everything I can teach you. You're ready for the world!
survivalassistant.dismissed.1: Alright, I'll leave you to it. Good luck out there!
survivalassistant.farewell.summary: You reached %s of %s goals. Keep exploring, and always sleep at night.
survivalassistant.recall: I'm here! What can I help you with?
survivalassistant.congrats.1: Congratulations! You reached every goal. You're a real survivor now!
survivalassistant.congrats.2: You don't need me anymore. Keep exploring, and always sleep at night.
survivalassistant.congrats.title: Congratulations!
survivalassistant.congrats.subtitle: All %s goals reached
survivalassistant.cmd.muted: The guide will stay quiet for %s minute(s). Sneak + right-click or /guide tip still works.
survivalassistant.cmd.unavailable: Your guide isn't available right now.
survivalassistant.tip.creeper.1: A creeper is close! Run away right now. It explodes about 1.5 seconds after hissing.
survivalassistant.tip.creeper.2: Creeper! Keep your distance: put at least 16 blocks between you, or a block between you and it.
survivalassistant.tip.danger.1: You're badly hurt and monsters are near. Back off and put blocks between you and them!
survivalassistant.tip.danger.2: Low health! Don't fight now. Dig into a wall, seal the hole and eat to recover.
survivalassistant.tip.hungry_eat.1: You're hungry: you can't sprint anymore. Eat something now!
survivalassistant.tip.hungry_eat.2: Eat! You only heal by yourself while your hunger bar is almost full.
survivalassistant.tip.hungry_hunt.1: You're hungry and have no food. Hunt cows, pigs, sheep or chickens, and cook the meat.
survivalassistant.tip.hungry_hunt.2: No food left! Look for animals, or pick apples from oak leaves. Don't let your hunger reach zero.
survivalassistant.tip.dusk.1: The sun is setting! Get inside now, or quickly dig into a hill and close the hole behind you.
survivalassistant.tip.dusk.2: Evening is coming. Monsters spawn in the dark: find shelter or sleep in your bed.
survivalassistant.tip.dusk.3: Almost night! No shelter? Dig three blocks down, stand in the hole and place a block above you.
survivalassistant.tip.night_outside.1: It's night and you're outside. Monsters are everywhere: go inside or dig in!
survivalassistant.tip.night_outside.2: Stay out of the dark! Seal yourself in and wait for morning, or sleep in a bed.
survivalassistant.tip.thunder.1: A thunderstorm! Monsters can spawn even during the day now. Find cover.
survivalassistant.tip.underground.1: You're underground without torches. Bring torches, and never dig straight down: there might be lava below!
survivalassistant.tip.underground.2: Careful down here! Dig like a staircase, not straight down, and keep some blocks with you.
survivalassistant.tip.wood.1: First things first: punch a tree! Hold the attack button on a log. Get about 10 to 16 logs.
survivalassistant.tip.wood.2: Everything starts with wood. Collect at least 10 logs. Don't leave floating tree tops behind!
survivalassistant.tip.wood.3: See that tree? Wood becomes planks, tools and your first shelter. Gather 10 or more logs.
survivalassistant.tip.crafting_table.1: Open your inventory, turn logs into planks (1 log = 4 planks), then make a crafting table from 4 planks.
survivalassistant.tip.crafting_table.2: Time for a crafting table: 4 planks in the 2x2 grid. Place it and you can craft much more.
survivalassistant.tip.wooden_pickaxe.1: Make sticks (2 planks on top of each other) and a wooden pickaxe: 3 planks on top, 2 sticks below.
survivalassistant.tip.wooden_pickaxe.2: You only need one wooden tool: a pickaxe. With it you can mine stone for much better tools.
survivalassistant.tip.stone_tools.1: Mine 15 to 20 stone with your pickaxe. Then make a stone pickaxe and a stone sword or axe.
survivalassistant.tip.stone_tools.2: Stone tools are much better than wood. Find some exposed stone, no need to dig deep!
survivalassistant.tip.stone_tools.3: Look, stone over there! Get some cobblestone and make a stone pickaxe and a weapon.
survivalassistant.tip.furnace.1: Make a furnace: 8 cobblestone in a ring on the crafting table. You'll need it to cook food and smelt ore.
survivalassistant.tip.furnace.2: A furnace turns raw meat into cooked meat, which fills you up much better. 8 cobblestone is all it takes.
survivalassistant.tip.food.1: Collect food before it gets dark: cows, pigs, sheep and chickens. Aim for at least 5 pieces.
survivalassistant.tip.food.2: Your hunger bar keeps dropping. Hunt a few animals and cook the meat in your furnace.
survivalassistant.tip.food.3: Food tip: cooked meat is much better than raw. Gather a stock of at least 5 pieces.
survivalassistant.tip.bed.1: Make a bed: 3 wool and 3 planks. Each sheep you defeat drops 1 wool; with shears you get 1 to 3.
survivalassistant.tip.bed.2: A bed lets you skip the night AND it becomes your respawn point. Look for 3 sheep!
survivalassistant.tip.torches.1: Look for black-speckled coal in the rock. 1 coal + 1 stick = 4 torches. Make at least 8.
survivalassistant.tip.torches.2: No coal? Smelt a log in your furnace to get charcoal; it works the same for torches.
survivalassistant.tip.shelter.1: Prepare a shelter before night: a small hut or a room dug into a hill. Close every gap and add torches.
survivalassistant.tip.shelter.2: Digging into a hill is the quickest shelter. Use a door so you can see when it's morning.
survivalassistant.tip.shelter.3: Monsters only spawn in complete darkness. A lit room with no open gaps is safe.
survivalassistant.tip.chest.1: Make a chest (8 planks in a ring) and store your valuables at home. Also note your coordinates with F3!
survivalassistant.tip.iron.1: Time for iron! Look for stone with beige-orange specks in cave entrances or cliffs, and smelt it in the furnace.
survivalassistant.tip.iron.2: Iron is the big step forward. Bring torches and blocks, and mine the iron you see in cave walls.
survivalassistant.tip.iron.3: Get at least 3 iron ore. Smelt the raw iron into ingots in your furnace.
survivalassistant.tip.shield.1: Make a shield: 6 planks and 1 iron ingot. It's the single best way to survive fights. Hold it in your off-hand.
survivalassistant.tip.shield.2: With a shield you can block arrows and even creeper explosions. Only 1 iron needed!
survivalassistant.tip.iron_pickaxe.1: Make an iron pickaxe (3 iron + 2 sticks). Now you can mine gold, redstone and diamonds.
survivalassistant.tip.iron_armor.1: Make iron armor, the chestplate first (8 iron). It protects you a lot better.
survivalassistant.tip.iron_armor.2: Armor saves lives. Collect more iron and make a chestplate, helmet, leggings and boots.
survivalassistant.tip.water_bucket.1: Make a bucket (3 iron) and fill it with water. It puts out fire, tames lava and breaks your fall.
survivalassistant.tip.farm.1: Start a farm: make a hoe, till dirt next to water and plant 6 seeds. Seeds drop from tall grass.
survivalassistant.tip.farm.2: Food that grows back by itself: plant wheat seeds, carrots or potatoes on tilled dirt near water.
survivalassistant.tip.bread.1: Harvest ripe wheat and bake bread: 3 wheat in a row on the crafting table. No furnace needed.
survivalassistant.tip.breed.1: Breed animals: give two cows or sheep wheat, two pigs carrots, two chickens seeds. Fence them in first.
survivalassistant.tip.breed.2: A small animal pen means meat, leather and wool without searching. Feed two animals the same food.
survivalassistant.tip.full_iron_armor.1: Complete your iron armor: helmet (5), chestplate (8), leggings (7) and boots (4 iron).
survivalassistant.tip.bow.1: Make a bow (3 sticks, 3 string from spiders) and 16 arrows (flint from gravel, stick, feather).
survivalassistant.tip.bow.2: With a bow you can deal with skeletons and creepers from a safe distance.
survivalassistant.tip.diamonds.1: Time for diamonds! Mine deep down with an iron pickaxe. Look at the environment card for the best height.
survivalassistant.tip.diamonds.2: Diamonds are deep and often near lava. Bring a water bucket and never dig straight down.
survivalassistant.tip.diamond_pickaxe.1: Make a diamond pickaxe (3 diamonds, 2 sticks). It's the only pickaxe that can mine obsidian.
survivalassistant.tip.obsidian.1: Collect 10 obsidian: pour water on still lava and mine it with your diamond pickaxe. Enough for a Nether portal.
survivalassistant.tip.obsidian.2: Careful around lava: stand to the side, and keep a block between you and the lava.
survivalassistant.tip.flint_and_steel.1: Make a flint and steel: 1 iron ingot and 1 flint. It lights your Nether portal later.
survivalassistant.tip.enchanting_table.1: Make an enchanting table: a book (3 paper + leather), 2 diamonds and 4 obsidian.
survivalassistant.praise.wood: Nice, enough wood to get started!
survivalassistant.praise.crafting_table: A crafting table! Now the real crafting begins.
survivalassistant.praise.food: Food in stock. You won't go hungry tonight.
survivalassistant.praise.bed: A bed! Sleep in it to skip the night and set your respawn point.
survivalassistant.praise.torches: Torches! Light keeps the monsters away.
survivalassistant.praise.shelter: You survived the first night. Great job!
survivalassistant.praise.chest: A chest for your treasures. Smart!
survivalassistant.praise.shield: A shield! Keep it in your off-hand.
survivalassistant.praise.iron_pickaxe: An iron pickaxe. Diamonds are within reach!
survivalassistant.praise.iron_armor: Iron armor! You're much tougher now.
survivalassistant.praise.water_bucket: A water bucket: every explorer's best friend.
survivalassistant.praise.farm: Your first farm! Food that grows back.
survivalassistant.praise.breed: Baby animals! Your own herd is growing.
survivalassistant.praise.full_iron_armor: Full armor: you're a tank now.
survivalassistant.praise.bow: Bow and arrows ready. Skeletons, beware!
survivalassistant.praise.diamonds: Diamonds! The best find in the game.
survivalassistant.praise.diamond_pickaxe: A diamond pickaxe: nothing can stop you now.
survivalassistant.praise.obsidian: Enough obsidian for a Nether portal.
survivalassistant.praise.enchanting_tabl: An enchanting table! Time to make your gear stronger.
survivalassistant.congrats.all.1: Congratulations! You finished every chapter. You know your way around Minecraft now!
survivalassistant.chapter.done: Well done! You finished the chapter %s.
survivalassistant.chapters.reminder: Still choosing? Click a chapter below, or let me go.
survivalassistant.chapters.leave_hover: Say goodbye to the guide (/guide dismiss)
survivalassistant.chapters.no_answer.1: I didn't hear from you, so I'll let you continue on your own. You're ready!
survivalassistant.chapters.unavailable: That chapter isn't open (yet), or it's already done. See /guide chapters.

survivalassistant.chapter.first_days.des: Wood, tools, a shelter, food and iron: survive your first nights.
survivalassistant.chapter.settling_in.de: A farm, full armor, diamonds and the things you need for a Nether portal.
survivalassistant.chapter.village.desc: Find a village, trade with villagers, earn emeralds and build an iron golem.
survivalassistant.chapter.nether.desc: Into the Nether and back safely: golden armor, a fortress, blaze rods and Nether wart.
survivalassistant.chapter.magic.desc: A brewing stand, your first potion, bookshelves, enchanting and an anvil.
survivalassistant.chapter.first_days.sta: Chapter 1 begins: let's get you through the first days.
survivalassistant.chapter.settling_in.st: Chapter 2 begins! I'll stay as long as you're working on it. First up: a farm.
survivalassistant.chapter.village.start: Off to a village! You'll find them on plains, in deserts, savannas, taigas and snowy plains.
survivalassistant.chapter.nether.start: To the Nether! Bring food, full armor, a bow and blocks to build with.
survivalassistant.chapter.magic.start: Time for some magic! You'll need the blaze rods and Nether wart from the Nether.
survivalassistant.place.nether: Welcome to the Nether! Never sleep here: beds explode. Piglins leave you alone if you wear a piece of golden armor, and lava flows fast here.
survivalassistant.place.village: A village! Villagers trade with emeralds. Ring the bell to send them indoors when danger comes.
survivalassistant.place.village_night: Night in the village: zombies hunt villagers and can turn them into zombie villagers. Stay inside and light up the paths.
survivalassistant.tip.ghast.1: A ghast! Hit its fireball back with your sword or fist, or get out of its sight.
survivalassistant.tip.ghast.2: Ghasts shoot fireballs from far away. Stay away from edges and hide behind cobblestone: it withstands their blasts.
survivalassistant.tip.piglins.1: Piglins nearby and you're not wearing gold! Put on a golden helmet or boots, or they'll attack.
survivalassistant.tip.piglins.2: Piglins attack anyone without golden armor. One golden piece is enough to keep them calm.
survivalassistant.tip.find_village.1: Look for a village: they're on plains, in deserts, savannas, taigas and snowy plains. From a hill you can spot the roofs.
survivalassistant.tip.find_village.2: Villages are easiest to find from high up. Climb a hill or build a pillar and look around.
survivalassistant.praise.find_village: A village! Lots of new neighbors.
survivalassistant.tip.first_trade.1: Right-click a villager to see what they buy and sell. Farmers buy crops, fletchers buy sticks.
survivalassistant.tip.first_trade.2: Villagers with a job trade with you. You can see their job on their clothes: a farmer wears a straw hat.
survivalassistant.tip.trades.1: The more you trade with a villager, the better their offers get: they level up.
survivalassistant.tip.trades.2: Sell things you have plenty of, like wheat, sticks or paper, and buy what you need.
survivalassistant.praise.trades: Five trades: you're a real merchant.
survivalassistant.tip.emeralds.1: Earn emeralds by selling crops, sticks or paper to villagers. Emerald ore is rare and only found in mountains.
survivalassistant.tip.emeralds.2: A wheat farm near the village is an easy emerald machine: farmers buy wheat.
survivalassistant.praise.emeralds: Ten emeralds! Time to go shopping.
survivalassistant.tip.enchanted_book.1: Place a lectern next to a villager without a job: they become a librarian, who sells enchanted books.
survivalassistant.tip.enchanted_book.2: Don't like a librarian's books? Break the lectern before your first trade and place it again for new offers.
survivalassistant.praise.enchanted_book: An enchanted book! Use it on an anvil.
survivalassistant.tip.iron_golem.1: Protect the village: place 4 iron blocks in a T shape and put a carved pumpkin on top.
survivalassistant.tip.iron_golem.2: Carve a pumpkin with shears (right-click it). The iron golem guards the village against zombies.
survivalassistant.praise.iron_golem: An iron golem! The village is safer now.
survivalassistant.tip.gold_armor.1: Before the Nether: make a golden helmet or boots and wear them. Piglins then leave you alone.
survivalassistant.tip.gold_armor.2: Gold ore is in the ground below Y 32; smelt it in a furnace. One piece of golden armor is enough.
survivalassistant.praise.gold_armor: Shiny! The piglins will like you.
survivalassistant.tip.enter_nether.1: Build a portal: an obsidian frame 4 wide and 5 high (the corners aren't needed), and light it with flint and steel.
survivalassistant.tip.enter_nether.2: Take food, armor, a bow, blocks and a pickaxe. Remember the way back to your portal!
survivalassistant.praise.enter_nether: You're in the Nether! Stay sharp.
survivalassistant.tip.find_fortress.1: Nether fortresses are big buildings of dark red bricks with long bridges. Explore carefully and mark your way.
survivalassistant.tip.find_fortress.2: Afraid of getting lost? Now and then build a small cobblestone pillar with a torch, so you can find your way back to the portal.
survivalassistant.praise.find_fortress: A fortress! Blazes and Nether wart live here.
survivalassistant.tip.blaze_rods.1: Blazes appear around a cage in the fortress. Fight them from behind a wall and grab the rods they drop.
survivalassistant.tip.blaze_rods.2: Blazes shoot fireballs and set you on fire. Snowballs hurt them, and a potion of fire resistance helps a lot.
survivalassistant.praise.blaze_rods: Blaze rods! The key to brewing.
survivalassistant.tip.nether_wart.1: Nether wart grows on soul sand in the fortress, often near the stairs. Pick the red plants.
survivalassistant.tip.nether_wart.2: Plant Nether wart on soul sand at home and it grows by itself, even in the overworld.
survivalassistant.praise.nether_wart: Nether wart: the base of almost every potion.
survivalassistant.tip.home_safe.1: Got your blaze rods? Head back through your portal to the overworld.
survivalassistant.tip.home_safe.2: Lost your portal? Build a new one: 1 block in the Nether is 8 blocks in the overworld.
survivalassistant.tip.brewing_stand.1: A brewing stand takes a blaze rod and 3 cobblestone. Place it at home.
survivalassistant.tip.brewing_stand.2: Turn a blaze rod into 2 blaze powder: that's the fuel for the brewing stand.
survivalassistant.praise.brewing_stand: A brewing stand! Let's make potions.
survivalassistant.tip.brew_potion.1: Fill glass bottles with water and brew Nether wart into them: that's the base. Then add an ingredient, like a golden carrot for night vision.
survivalassistant.tip.brew_potion.2: Handy potions: healing (glistering melon slice), fire resistance (magma cream) and swiftness (sugar).
survivalassistant.praise.brew_potion: Your first potion! A real alchemist.
survivalassistant.tip.bookshelves.1: Place bookshelves around your enchanting table with one air block in between. 15 shelves give the strongest enchantments.
survivalassistant.tip.bookshelves.2: A bookshelf takes 6 planks and 3 books; a book is 3 paper and leather. Paper is made from sugar cane.
survivalassistant.tip.level_30.1: You get experience from mining coal and other ores, defeating monsters, breeding animals, trading and smelting.
survivalassistant.tip.level_30.2: Level 30 unlocks the strongest enchantments. Tip: don't die, or you lose most of your experience.
survivalassistant.praise.level_30: Level 30! Ready for the best enchantments.
survivalassistant.tip.enchant.1: Put a tool, weapon or armor in the enchanting table with lapis lazuli and pick an enchantment.
survivalassistant.tip.enchant.2: Lapis lazuli is a blue ore deep underground. The bottom option costs 3 lapis and 3 levels.
survivalassistant.tip.anvil.1: An anvil takes 3 iron blocks and 4 iron ingots: 31 ingots in total.
survivalassistant.tip.anvil.2: With an anvil you repair tools, rename items and put enchanted books on your gear.
survivalassistant.praise.anvil: An anvil! Your gear lasts much longer now.
survivalassistant.chapter.ocean.title: The ocean
survivalassistant.chapter.explorer.title: Exploring
survivalassistant.chapter.husbandry.desc: Tame an animal, milk, sugar cane, fishing, honey and a horse of your own.
survivalassistant.chapter.ocean.desc: A boat, a shipwreck, buried treasure, a turtle shell and a trident.
survivalassistant.chapter.explorer.desc: A map, a spyglass, a temple, the trial chambers and a vault.
survivalassistant.chapter.husbandry.star: Life on the farm! First up: make a friend. Wolves love bones, cats love raw fish.
survivalassistant.chapter.ocean.start: To the sea! Make a boat first: it's much faster than swimming.
survivalassistant.chapter.explorer.start: Let's explore! A map helps: you'll always see where you've been.
survivalassistant.place.desert_temple: A desert temple! In the hidden room below, never step on the pressure plate in the middle: it's wired to TNT. Dig in from the side.
survivalassistant.place.jungle_temple: A jungle temple! Watch for tripwires in the corridors: they fire arrows. A lever puzzle opens a hidden chest.
survivalassistant.place.trial_chambers: Trial chambers! Trial spawners send waves of mobs. Beat them for trial keys, which open the vaults. Watch out for the breeze.
survivalassistant.place.wreck: A shipwreck or a ruin. Drowned often lurk here, some with tridents. Keep an eye on your air and swim up in time.
survivalassistant.tip.tame_animal.1: Tame a wolf with bones or a cat with raw cod or salmon. A tamed wolf fights alongside you.
survivalassistant.tip.tame_animal.2: Parrots are tamed with seeds, horses by riding them until hearts appear. Tamed animals stay your friends.
survivalassistant.tip.milk.1: Use an empty bucket on a cow (or a goat) to get milk.
survivalassistant.tip.milk.2: Milk takes away all effects, also bad ones like poison. Handy to keep one with you.
survivalassistant.tip.sugar_cane.1: Sugar cane grows on sand, dirt or grass right next to water. Cut it above the bottom piece and it grows back.
survivalassistant.tip.sugar_cane.2: Plant sugar cane along a stream for a steady supply: you need it for paper, books and sugar.
survivalassistant.praise.sugar_cane: Sixteen sugar cane: enough for a pile of paper.
survivalassistant.tip.fishing.1: Make a fishing rod from 3 sticks and 2 string. Cast it into water and reel it in when the bobber dips.
survivalassistant.tip.fishing.2: Fish bite faster in the rain. Sometimes you even reel in treasure, like an enchanted book.
survivalassistant.tip.honey.1: Place a campfire under a bee nest: the smoke keeps the bees calm. Then use a glass bottle on the full nest.
survivalassistant.tip.honey.2: A glass bottle is made from glass, which you get by smelting sand. Without smoke, the bees will attack.
survivalassistant.tip.horse.1: Tame a horse by getting on it with an empty hand until hearts appear. You'll find horses on plains and savannas.
survivalassistant.tip.horse.2: To steer a horse you need a saddle: 3 leather and an iron ingot. Put it on the tamed horse.
survivalassistant.praise.horse: Your own horse! Explore faster than ever.
survivalassistant.tip.boat.1: A boat takes 5 planks of the same wood. Place it on water, get in and paddle away.
survivalassistant.tip.boat.2: In a boat you travel much faster than swimming, and on ice it goes even faster.
survivalassistant.praise.boat: A boat! The sea is yours.
survivalassistant.tip.find_wreck.1: Shipwrecks lie in oceans and on beaches, ocean ruins under the water. Look out from your boat, or dive down.
survivalassistant.tip.find_wreck.2: The chests in shipwrecks often hold a treasure map. Ocean ruins have suspicious sand you can brush.
survivalassistant.praise.find_wreck: A wreck! Let's see what it holds.
survivalassistant.tip.treasure.1: Follow a treasure map from a shipwreck to the red X. The chest is buried under the sand, usually on a beach.
survivalassistant.tip.treasure.2: Every buried treasure chest holds a heart of the sea. Dig straight down at the X.
survivalassistant.praise.treasure: A heart of the sea! Real pirate treasure.
survivalassistant.tip.turtle_helmet.1: Breed turtles with seagrass: they lay eggs on the beach. Babies drop a turtle scute when they grow up.
survivalassistant.tip.turtle_helmet.2: Five turtle scutes make a turtle shell. Wearing it lets you breathe a little longer underwater.
survivalassistant.praise.turtle_helmet: A turtle shell! Breathe easy underwater.
survivalassistant.tip.trident.1: Tridents only come from drowned: zombies in the water. A drowned holding a trident can drop it.
survivalassistant.tip.trident.2: Careful: drowned with a trident throw it at you. Fight them at the waterline, not deep underwater.
survivalassistant.praise.trident: A trident! The weapon of the sea.
survivalassistant.tip.map.1: A map takes 8 paper around a compass. Hold it and right-click to draw the land around you.
survivalassistant.tip.map.2: A compass is 4 iron ingots around redstone. With a map you can always see where you've been.
survivalassistant.praise.map: A map! You'll never be lost again.
survivalassistant.tip.spyglass.1: A spyglass takes 2 copper ingots and an amethyst shard. Amethyst grows in purple geodes underground.
survivalassistant.tip.spyglass.2: Use the spyglass to look far ahead: spot villages, temples and danger from a safe spot.
survivalassistant.praise.spyglass: A spyglass! Now you can see far away.
survivalassistant.tip.find_temple.1: Desert temples are sandstone pyramids in the desert, jungle temples are mossy buildings in the jungle.
survivalassistant.tip.find_temple.2: Temples hide treasure chests, but also traps. Read my warning when you go inside.
survivalassistant.praise.find_temple: A temple! Careful with the traps.
survivalassistant.tip.trial_chambers.1: Trial chambers are big underground halls of copper and tuff. They're often found while mining or caving.
survivalassistant.tip.trial_chambers.2: Cartographers in villages sometimes sell a map to the trial chambers.
survivalassistant.praise.trial_chambers: The trial chambers! Time for a challenge.
survivalassistant.tip.open_vault.1: Beat a trial spawner to get a trial key, then use it on a vault for its loot.
survivalassistant.tip.open_vault.2: Each vault opens once per player. Bring food, armor and blocks: the waves can be tough.
survivalassistant.chapter.redstone.title: Redstone
survivalassistant.chapter.end.title: The End
survivalassistant.chapter.redstone.desc: Redstone dust, an automatic iron door, a piston, a repeater and a hopper.
survivalassistant.chapter.end.desc: Eyes of ender, the stronghold, the End, the ender dragon, an end city and an elytra.
survivalassistant.chapter.redstone.start: Time to tinker! First you need redstone: it's deep underground.
survivalassistant.chapter.end.start: The final adventure! Make sure you have full armor, a bow with plenty of arrows, food and blocks.
survivalassistant.place.stronghold: A stronghold! Look for the portal room: an end portal above a pool of lava. Careful with stone bricks: silverfish hide in some of them.
survivalassistant.place.end: Welcome to the End! Don't look endermen in the eyes. Destroy the end crystals on the pillars first: they heal the dragon. And never fall into the void.
survivalassistant.place.end_city: An end city! Shulker bullets make you float up: stay away from edges, milk stops it. A ship nearby may hold an elytra.
survivalassistant.tip.redstone_dust.1: Redstone ore lies deep underground, below Y 16, and is most common near the bottom. Mine it with an iron pickaxe or better.
survivalassistant.tip.redstone_dust.2: Redstone dust carries power like a wire. Place it on the ground to connect a lever, button or plate to what it should power.
survivalassistant.tip.iron_door.1: An iron door only opens with redstone. Put a pressure plate or button next to it and walk through.
survivalassistant.tip.iron_door.2: Iron doors keep zombies out: they can't break them. A pressure plate on both sides makes a door that opens by itself.
survivalassistant.tip.piston.1: Place a piston and power it with a lever or a redstone torch: it pushes the block in front of it.
survivalassistant.tip.piston.2: With a slimeball you make a sticky piston, which also pulls the block back. That's how hidden doors work.
survivalassistant.tip.repeater.1: Redstone dust only carries power 15 blocks. A repeater makes the signal strong again, and can delay it.
survivalassistant.tip.repeater.2: Right-click a repeater to change its delay. The signal only goes one way: in at the back, out at the front.
survivalassistant.praise.repeater: A repeater! Now your signals go far.
survivalassistant.tip.hopper.1: A hopper moves items into the chest or furnace it points at. Sneak while placing it against a chest.
survivalassistant.tip.hopper.2: Put a hopper under a furnace and a chest under the hopper: the cooked items collect themselves.
survivalassistant.praise.hopper: A hopper! Let the machines do the work.
survivalassistant.tip.ender_pearls.1: Endermen drop ender pearls. Fight them under a 2-block-high roof: they're 3 blocks tall and can't follow you.
survivalassistant.tip.ender_pearls.2: Clerics in villages sometimes sell ender pearls too. Don't look endermen in the eyes, unless you want a fight.
survivalassistant.praise.ender_pearls: Twelve ender pearls! Ready for the eyes.
survivalassistant.tip.eyes_of_ender.1: An eye of ender is an ender pearl with blaze powder. You need up to 12 to open the end portal.
survivalassistant.tip.eyes_of_ender.2: Make a few extra: a thrown eye sometimes breaks while showing you the way.
survivalassistant.praise.eyes_of_ender: Twelve eyes! They'll show you the way.
survivalassistant.tip.find_stronghold.1: Throw an eye of ender: it flies towards the stronghold. Follow it, and where it sinks into the ground, dig down.
survivalassistant.tip.find_stronghold.2: Throw the eye again every few hundred blocks. When it goes down instead of forward, the stronghold is below you.
survivalassistant.praise.find_stronghold: The stronghold! Now find the portal room.
survivalassistant.tip.enter_end.1: Put an eye of ender in every empty frame of the end portal. When the portal opens, jump in.
survivalassistant.tip.enter_end.2: Before you jump: bring full armor, a bow with lots of arrows, food, blocks and a bed spawn at home. There is no way back until the dragon is gone.
survivalassistant.tip.dragon.1: Shoot the end crystals on the tall pillars first; they heal the dragon. Some sit in cages: climb up and break them.
survivalassistant.tip.dragon.2: Hit the dragon when it lands on the portal in the middle. Stay out of its purple breath.
survivalassistant.praise.dragon: The dragon is defeated! You did it!
survivalassistant.tip.end_city.1: After the dragon, a gateway appears at the edge of the island. Throw an ender pearl into it to reach the outer islands.
survivalassistant.tip.end_city.2: End cities are tall purple towers on the outer islands. They hold the best loot in the game.
survivalassistant.praise.end_city: An end city! Watch out for the shulkers.
survivalassistant.tip.elytra.1: Some end cities have a ship. The elytra hangs in an item frame inside; break the frame to take it.
survivalassistant.tip.elytra.2: Wear the elytra, jump from a height and press jump again to glide. Fireworks give you a boost.
survivalassistant.praise.elytra: Wings! The whole world is yours now.
survivalassistant.congrats.all.2: You don't need me anymore. You even beat the dragon: the whole world is yours!
survivalassistant.chapter.wither.title: The Wither and the beacon
survivalassistant.chapter.raids.title: Raids and Illagers
survivalassistant.chapter.netherite.desc: Ancient debris, a netherite ingot, a bastion, the upgrade template, netherite gear and a respawn anchor.
survivalassistant.chapter.wither.desc: Wither skeleton skulls, soul sand, summon and defeat the Wither, a beacon and a full beacon.
survivalassistant.chapter.deep_dark.desc: An ancient city, sneaking past sculk, echo shards and a recovery compass. Never fight the warden!
survivalassistant.chapter.raids.desc: A pillager outpost, the raid captain, an ominous bottle, winning a raid and a totem of undying.
survivalassistant.chapter.netherite.star: Time for the strongest material in the game! Netherite starts with ancient debris, deep in the Nether.
survivalassistant.chapter.wither.start: The hardest fight there is. Prepare well: armor, a good sword, a bow, healing potions and milk.
survivalassistant.chapter.deep_dark.star: Into the dark! Sneak everywhere, bring wool and plenty of torches, and leave the warden alone.
survivalassistant.chapter.raids.start: Time to defend the villages! Raids are tough, so bring good armor, a shield and a bow or crossbow.
survivalassistant.place.bastion: A bastion! Piglin brutes always attack, even if you wear gold. Don't open chests or mine gold while piglins can see you, and watch out for lava drops.
survivalassistant.place.ancient_city: An ancient city in the deep dark. Sneak all the time and avoid the sculk shriekers: three shrieks call the warden. If it comes, don't fight: sneak away.
survivalassistant.place.outpost: A pillager outpost! The captain with the banner drops an ominous bottle. Drinking it gives Bad Omen: the next village you enter gets raided.
survivalassistant.place.wither: A wither skeleton skull! Three of them summon the Wither. Never do that near your home or a village: it destroys everything. Fight it deep underground.
survivalassistant.tip.warden.1: A warden is near! Don't fight it. Sneak away slowly: it can't see, it hunts by sound and smell.
survivalassistant.tip.warden.2: Warden! Stand still or sneak away. Throw a snowball away from you to lead it somewhere else.
survivalassistant.tip.ancient_debris.1: Ancient debris lies in the Nether between Y 8 and Y 22, most of it around Y 15. It looks like brown, ringed stone. You need a diamond pickaxe.
survivalassistant.tip.ancient_debris.2: Dig long tunnels at Y 15 in the Nether and look at the walls. Ancient debris is rare, so be patient.
survivalassistant.praise.ancient_debris: Ancient debris! Smelt it into netherite scrap.
survivalassistant.tip.netherite_ingot.1: Smelt ancient debris into netherite scrap. 4 scrap and 4 gold ingots make one netherite ingot.
survivalassistant.tip.netherite_ingot.2: One netherite ingot upgrades one piece of diamond gear, so collect plenty of debris.
survivalassistant.praise.netherite_ingot: A netherite ingot! The strongest metal there is.
survivalassistant.tip.find_bastion.1: Bastions are huge buildings of dark blackstone in the Nether, full of piglins and treasure.
survivalassistant.tip.find_bastion.2: Look for bastions from a safe spot. Piglin brutes guard them: they always attack, gold or no gold.
survivalassistant.tip.upgrade_template.1: The netherite upgrade smithing template is found in bastion chests, almost always in the treasure room.
survivalassistant.tip.upgrade_template.2: Copy a template at the crafting table with 7 diamonds and a block of netherrack, so you never run out.
survivalassistant.praise.upgrade_templat: An upgrade template! Now to the smithing table.
survivalassistant.tip.netherite_gear.1: At a smithing table: template, diamond tool or armor, and a netherite ingot. Enchantments stay on.
survivalassistant.tip.netherite_gear.2: Netherite gear is the strongest there is, and it doesn't burn in lava: it floats.
survivalassistant.tip.respawn_anchor.1: A respawn anchor takes 6 crying obsidian and 3 glowstone. Charge it with glowstone to respawn in the Nether.
survivalassistant.tip.respawn_anchor.2: Only use a respawn anchor in the Nether: in the overworld it explodes when you try to set your spawn.
survivalassistant.praise.respawn_anchor: A respawn anchor! A home in the Nether.
survivalassistant.tip.wither_skulls.1: Wither skeletons live in Nether fortresses. Now and then one drops its skull; a sword with Looting helps.
survivalassistant.tip.wither_skulls.2: Wither skeletons give you the Wither effect. Bring milk to drink it away.
survivalassistant.praise.wither_skulls: Three skulls! Enough for the Wither.
survivalassistant.tip.soul_sand.1: Soul sand lies in soul sand valleys and around fortresses in the Nether. Soul soil works too.
survivalassistant.tip.soul_sand.2: The Wither is built like a T: 4 soul sand with 3 skulls on top. The last skull wakes it.
survivalassistant.praise.soul_sand: Four soul sand: the base is ready.
survivalassistant.tip.summon_wither.1: Build the T of soul sand and place the 3 skulls on top. Do it deep underground, far from home.
survivalassistant.tip.summon_wither.2: The Wither explodes when it wakes up, shoots skulls and breaks blocks. Below half health, arrows bounce off it.
survivalassistant.praise.summon_wither: The Wither is awake! Fight hard.
survivalassistant.tip.nether_star.1: Defeat the Wither: it drops a nether star. Use a sword with Smite and drink milk against the Wither effect.
survivalassistant.tip.nether_star.2: A nether star can't burn or explode, and it never disappears. Take it home safely.
survivalassistant.praise.nether_star: A nether star! You beat the Wither.
survivalassistant.tip.beacon.1: A beacon takes 5 glass, a nether star and 3 obsidian. Place it on a 3x3 platform of iron, gold, emerald or diamond blocks.
survivalassistant.tip.beacon.2: Pay the beacon with an iron ingot, gold, an emerald or a diamond, and pick a power like Haste or Speed.
survivalassistant.praise.beacon: A beacon! A beam of light into the sky.
survivalassistant.tip.full_beacon.1: A full beacon stands on a 4-layer pyramid: 9 + 25 + 49 + 81 = 164 blocks of iron, gold, emerald or diamond.
survivalassistant.tip.full_beacon.2: A full beacon reaches furthest and unlocks a second power, like Regeneration.
survivalassistant.praise.full_beacon: A full beacon! The ultimate building project.
Ancient cities lie in the deep dark, far below Y 0, often under mountains. Look for black sculk spreading over the stone.
In the deep dark, light up carefully and keep wool with you: walking on wool makes no vibrations.
survivalassistant.tip.sneak_past.1: Sculk sensors notice footsteps, falling items and fighting. Sneak past a sensor: sneaking makes no vibrations.
survivalassistant.tip.sneak_past.2: Never trigger a sculk shrieker: three shrieks and the warden comes.
survivalassistant.tip.echo_shards.1: Echo shards are found in the chests of ancient cities. You need 8.
survivalassistant.tip.echo_shards.2: Open chests quietly and keep sneaking. Leave right away if a shrieker goes off.
survivalassistant.tip.recovery_compass.1: A recovery compass is 8 echo shards around a compass. It always points to where you last died.
survivalassistant.tip.recovery_compass.2: With a recovery compass you find your lost items again after dying, even far away.
survivalassistant.praise.recovery_compas: A recovery compass! Never lose your things again.
survivalassistant.tip.find_outpost.1: Pillager outposts are dark wooden towers with white-and-grey banners. They're often near villages.
survivalassistant.tip.find_outpost.2: Pillagers shoot crossbows. Approach behind cover and bring a shield.
survivalassistant.praise.find_outpost: An outpost! Watch out for the crossbows.
survivalassistant.tip.raid_captain.1: The captain is the pillager carrying a banner on its head. Defeat it: it drops an ominous bottle.
survivalassistant.tip.raid_captain.2: Fight the captain away from its friends: lure it out, or shoot it with a bow.
survivalassistant.tip.ominous_bottle.1: Raid captains drop ominous bottles. Drinking one gives you Bad Omen.
survivalassistant.tip.ominous_bottle.2: Only drink the bottle when you're ready: with Bad Omen, the next village you enter gets raided.
survivalassistant.praise.ominous_bottle: An ominous bottle. Drink it only when you're ready!
survivalassistant.tip.win_raid.1: Drink the ominous bottle and walk into a village: the raid starts. Defeat every wave of pillagers, vindicators and ravagers.
survivalassistant.tip.win_raid.2: Before the raid: build walls, place the villagers safely, and keep beds and light around. You can ring the bell to send villagers inside.
survivalassistant.praise.win_raid: Hero of the Village! The villagers give you discounts.
survivalassistant.tip.totem.1: Evokers drop a totem of undying. You meet them in raids and in woodland mansions.
survivalassistant.tip.totem.2: Hold the totem in your offhand: if you would die, it saves you once.
survivalassistant.praise.totem: A totem of undying! One extra life.
survivalassistant.chapter.trials.title: Trial challenges
survivalassistant.chapter.archaeology.de: A brush, trail ruins, a pottery sherd, a decorated pot, an armor trim and a sniffer egg.
survivalassistant.chapter.trials.desc: Breeze rods, wind charges, an ominous vault, the heavy core and the mace.
survivalassistant.chapter.happy_ghast.de: A dried ghast, bring it back to life, raise the ghastling, a harness and a flight together.
survivalassistant.chapter.automation.des: An observer, an automatic furnace, a copper bulb and the crafter.
survivalassistant.chapter.archaeology.st: Let's dig up the past! First make a brush: a feather, a copper ingot and a stick.
survivalassistant.chapter.trials.start: Back to the trial chambers for the real challenge. Bring good armor, food and a shield.
survivalassistant.chapter.happy_ghast.st: Time to make a flying friend! It starts with a dried ghast, from the Nether or from ghast tears.
survivalassistant.chapter.automation.sta: Let the machines do the work! You'll need redstone, nether quartz and a blaze rod.
survivalassistant.place.trail_ruins: Trail ruins! Brush the suspicious gravel slowly with a brush. Never mine it: then the treasure is gone.
survivalassistant.tip.brush.1: A brush takes a feather, a copper ingot and a stick, stacked on top of each other.
survivalassistant.tip.brush.2: Use the brush on suspicious sand or gravel: hold right-click and the hidden item slowly appears.
survivalassistant.tip.find_trail_ruins.1: Trail ruins lie half buried in forests, taigas and jungles. Look for bits of terracotta and brick sticking out of the ground.
survivalassistant.tip.find_trail_ruins.2: Dig the ruins out carefully: most of them is underground, with suspicious gravel in between.
survivalassistant.tip.sherd.1: Brush suspicious sand or gravel in trail ruins, desert temples, desert wells or ocean ruins. Sherds are a common find.
survivalassistant.tip.sherd.2: Mining suspicious blocks destroys them. Always use the brush.
survivalassistant.praise.sherd: A pottery sherd! A piece of history.
survivalassistant.tip.decorated_pot.1: A decorated pot takes 4 sherds or bricks in a diamond shape. Each sherd shows its picture on a side of the pot.
survivalassistant.tip.decorated_pot.2: Place the pot and put items in it: one pot holds a whole stack of one item.
survivalassistant.praise.decorated_pot: A decorated pot! A real museum piece.
survivalassistant.tip.armor_trim.1: At a smithing table: a trim template, an armor piece and a material like iron, gold, emerald or amethyst.
survivalassistant.tip.armor_trim.2: Trim templates are found in structures like trail ruins and outposts. Copy one with 7 diamonds.
survivalassistant.tip.sniffer_egg.1: Brush suspicious sand in warm ocean ruins: sometimes a sniffer egg comes out.
survivalassistant.tip.sniffer_egg.2: Place the egg on moss and it hatches faster. A sniffer digs up ancient seeds that grow into rare plants.
survivalassistant.praise.sniffer_egg: A sniffer egg! An ancient animal returns.
survivalassistant.tip.breeze_rods.1: Breezes live in the trial chambers. They deflect arrows, so fight them up close and dodge their wind charges.
survivalassistant.tip.breeze_rods.2: Each breeze drops a breeze rod. You need one for the mace, the other for wind charges.
survivalassistant.tip.wind_charge.1: One breeze rod gives 4 wind charges. Throw one at your feet to jump high, or at enemies to push them away.
survivalassistant.tip.wind_charge.2: A wind charge under your feet breaks your fall: handy when you jump down.
survivalassistant.praise.wind_charge: Wind charges! Jump to the sky.
survivalassistant.tip.ominous_vault.1: Drink an ominous bottle and enter the trial chambers: the spawners turn ominous. Beat them for an ominous trial key.
survivalassistant.tip.ominous_vault.2: Ominous trials are much harder: more and stronger mobs. Open an ominous vault with the ominous key.
survivalassistant.praise.ominous_vault: An ominous vault opened! You're brave.
survivalassistant.tip.heavy_core.1: The heavy core is rare loot from ominous vaults. Keep beating ominous trials until you find it.
survivalassistant.tip.heavy_core.2: Every ominous vault opens once per player, so explore different trial chambers.
survivalassistant.praise.heavy_core: The heavy core! Now make the mace.
survivalassistant.tip.mace.1: A mace is a heavy core on a breeze rod. The further you fall before a hit, the harder it strikes.
survivalassistant.tip.mace.2: Jump with a wind charge and hit on the way down: the mace also cancels your fall damage.
survivalassistant.praise.mace: The mace! The heaviest weapon in the game.
survivalassistant.tip.dried_ghast.1: Dried ghasts lie in fossils in soul sand valleys in the Nether. You can also craft one: 8 ghast tears around soul sand.
survivalassistant.tip.dried_ghast.2: A dried ghast looks like a small, sad block. It's waiting for water.
survivalassistant.praise.dried_ghast: A dried ghast! Let's bring it back to life.
survivalassistant.task.hydrate_ghast: Put the dried ghast in water
survivalassistant.tip.hydrate_ghast.1: Place the dried ghast in water. It slowly fills up again, and after about 20 minutes a ghastling appears.
survivalassistant.tip.hydrate_ghast.2: Keep it in the water the whole time; you can see it grow fuller.
survivalassistant.tip.ghastling.1: A ghastling is a baby happy ghast. It grows up in about 20 minutes; feeding it snowballs makes it grow faster.
survivalassistant.tip.ghastling.2: Ghastlings like to follow you. Keep it close and safe, away from lava.
survivalassistant.tip.harness.1: A harness takes 3 leather, 2 glass and 1 wool. The wool's color gives the harness its color.
survivalassistant.tip.harness.2: Put the harness on a grown-up happy ghast with right-click.
survivalassistant.tip.ride_happy_ghast.1: Right-click the happy ghast with the harness to climb on. It flies where you look; up to 4 players fit.
survivalassistant.tip.ride_happy_ghast.2: A happy ghast is slow but safe: perfect for building high up or looking over the land.
survivalassistant.tip.observer.1: An observer takes 6 cobblestone, 2 redstone and a nether quartz. It sends a pulse when the block in front of it changes.
survivalassistant.tip.observer.2: Point an observer at sugar cane with a piston next to it: a farm that harvests itself.
survivalassistant.tip.auto_smelter.1: Put a hopper on top of a furnace and another hopper under it. Items go in at the top and come out at the bottom.
survivalassistant.tip.auto_smelter.2: Put a chest on each hopper: fill the top chest with ore and collect the ingots from the bottom one.
survivalassistant.praise.auto_smelter: An automatic furnace! It smelts while you play.
survivalassistant.tip.copper_bulb.1: A copper bulb takes 3 copper blocks, a blaze rod and a redstone dust. Each redstone pulse switches it on or off.
survivalassistant.tip.copper_bulb.2: Copper bulbs stay on until the next pulse: handy as a memory in redstone circuits.
survivalassistant.tip.crafter.1: A crafter takes 5 iron ingots, a crafting table, 2 redstone and a dropper. It crafts when it gets a redstone pulse.
survivalassistant.tip.crafter.2: Click empty slots in the crafter to lock them; then hoppers fill only the slots you need.
survivalassistant.task.crafter_crafts: Let a crafter craft a crafter
survivalassistant.tip.crafter_crafts.1: Put the crafter recipe in a crafter: iron, a crafting table, redstone and a dropper. Give it a pulse and it makes another crafter.
survivalassistant.tip.crafter_crafts.2: Use a button for the pulse, and collect the result with a hopper.
survivalassistant.praise.crafter_crafts: A crafter crafting crafters! Master of automation.
survivalassistant.alert.lit_safe: Well lit: no monsters spawn here
survivalassistant.safe.lit.1: Nice and bright here: no monsters can spawn in this light.
survivalassistant.safe.lit.2: This spot is well lit. No new monsters here, but keep an eye on the dark edges.
survivalassistant.skin.list_header: Guide skins (%s in the skins folder). Click one to use it:
survivalassistant.skin.empty: No skins yet: put 64x64 skin PNGs in the folder and use /guideskin reload.
survivalassistant.skin.not_found: Skin '%s' not found. Use /guideskin list (or /guideskin reload after adding files).
survivalassistant.skin.set: The guide now uses the skin '%s'. Only you see this.
survivalassistant.skin.reloaded: Skins folder read again: %s skin(s) found.
survivalassistant.skin.bad_file: Skipped %s: a skin must be a 64x64 PNG.
survivalassistant.skin.fallback: Guide skin '%s' is missing, so the guide uses its own skin.
survivalassistant.cmd.musings_on: The guide shares its thoughts about the places and animals you meet again.
survivalassistant.cmd.musings_off: The guide keeps its musings to itself. Tips and warnings keep working.
survivalassistant.cmd.musings_all: The guide muses everywhere, also (quietly) in the Nether, the End and the Deep Dark.
survivalassistant.muse.plains.build: I can picture a farm here: a red barn, fenced pastures and a wheat field down by the water.
survivalassistant.muse.plains.scene: Listen to the wind over the grass. Out here you can see trouble coming from far away.
survivalassistant.muse.plains.lore: What would you build here? I'd put a windmill on top of that hill.
survivalassistant.muse.forest.build: A treehouse between these oaks would be lovely, with a rope ladder and lanterns.
survivalassistant.muse.forest.scene: Smell that? Fresh leaves and moss. A forest always feels alive.
survivalassistant.muse.forest.lore: I like to think every big oak here has seen a hundred sunrises.
survivalassistant.muse.birch_forest.buil: White birch planks make a bright cottage. Imagine one here with a flower garden.
survivalassistant.muse.birch_forest.scen: These birch trees look like someone painted them. Such a calm place.
survivalassistant.muse.birch_forest.lore: If you could live in any forest, would it be this one?
survivalassistant.muse.dark_forest.build: A cozy dark oak cabin full of lanterns would make this gloomy forest feel safe.
survivalassistant.muse.dark_forest.scene: It's so dark under these trees that even at noon it feels like evening. Stay close.
survivalassistant.muse.dark_forest.lore: Woodland mansions hide in dark forests like this one. Best admired from far away, for now.
survivalassistant.muse.pale_garden.build: A pale oak house with soft lights would look like something out of a fairy tale.
survivalassistant.muse.pale_garden.scene: Everything here is grey and quiet... almost too quiet.
survivalassistant.muse.pale_garden.lore: The creaking hearts in these trees sleep during the day. I'd rather not wake them.
survivalassistant.muse.dappled_forest.bu: Sunlight falls through the leaves in little patches here. A garden house would fit right in.
survivalassistant.muse.dappled_forest.sc: Look at those patches of light on the ground. It's like the forest is smiling.
survivalassistant.muse.dappled_forest.lo: Do you like bright forests like this one, or dark and mysterious ones?
survivalassistant.muse.taiga.build: A log cabin with a smoking chimney and a stack of firewood: that's what this place needs.
survivalassistant.muse.taiga.scene: Spruce trees and sweet berries... it smells like winter is on its way.
survivalassistant.muse.taiga.lore: Foxes love these woods. Keep an eye out for one curled up asleep.
survivalassistant.muse.snowy.build: An igloo! Or a warm stone house with a fireplace. Either way, somewhere cozy.
survivalassistant.muse.snowy.scene: Everything is so quiet in the snow. Even your footsteps sound soft.
survivalassistant.muse.snowy.lore: Polar bears are gentle, unless you get too close to their cubs.
survivalassistant.muse.mountains.build: A lookout tower on a peak like that... you could see the whole world from up there.
survivalassistant.muse.mountains.scene: What a view! Mind the edges though, it's a long way down.
survivalassistant.muse.mountains.lore: Shall we climb all the way up some day, just to watch the sunrise?
survivalassistant.muse.meadow.build: A beekeeper's cottage surrounded by flowers would be perfect here.
survivalassistant.muse.meadow.scene: Flowers everywhere and bees humming. This might be the prettiest place we've seen.
survivalassistant.muse.meadow.lore: Somewhere up high, cherry trees turn whole hills pink. I'd love to see that.
survivalassistant.muse.desert.build: A sandstone market with colorful awnings, like a little desert town. Doesn't that sound great?
survivalassistant.muse.desert.scene: Hot sand as far as you can see. Good thing we never get thirsty in this world.
survivalassistant.muse.desert.lore: Somewhere under the sand, old pyramids hide their treasure... and their traps.
survivalassistant.muse.badlands.build: Picture a wild-west town here: wooden saloons and a mine track into the hills.
survivalassistant.muse.badlands.scene: Look at all these red and orange layers. Like a giant cake made of stone.
survivalassistant.muse.badlands.lore: Old abandoned mineshafts poke out of the hills here. Miners must have loved this place.
survivalassistant.muse.savanna.build: An acacia lodge on stilts, looking out over the grassland. That would be my dream house.
survivalassistant.muse.savanna.scene: Flat-topped trees and golden grass. It feels warm just looking at it.
survivalassistant.muse.savanna.lore: Horses roam these plains. Have you ever ridden one?
survivalassistant.muse.jungle.build: A treehouse village high in the jungle canopy, with rope bridges between the trees!
survivalassistant.muse.jungle.scene: Listen: parrots, rustling leaves, maybe an ocelot sneaking around.
survivalassistant.muse.jungle.lore: Jungle temples are tucked away in here, full of tripwires. Watch your step.
survivalassistant.muse.swamp.build: A hut on stilts above the water, like a witch's house... but a friendly one, of course.
survivalassistant.muse.swamp.scene: Croaking frogs, murky water and lily pads everywhere. Swamps have their own charm.
survivalassistant.muse.swamp.lore: On some nights slimes come bouncing through swamps under the moon.
survivalassistant.muse.shore.build: A little fishing hut with a wooden dock would be perfect on this shore.
survivalassistant.muse.shore.scene: The sound of the water is so relaxing. Shall we sit here for a moment?
survivalassistant.muse.shore.lore: Do you like fishing? With a rod and some patience you can catch fish, and sometimes treasure.
survivalassistant.muse.ocean.build: An underwater base with glass walls... that's a project for later!
survivalassistant.muse.ocean.scene: The ocean goes on forever. Who knows what lies beneath.
survivalassistant.muse.ocean.lore: Shipwrecks sometimes hide treasure maps. Imagine finding one!
survivalassistant.muse.mushroom.build: A house made of giant mushrooms! This is the place for it.
survivalassistant.muse.mushroom.scene: Giant mushrooms and mooshrooms. It feels like a dream here.
survivalassistant.muse.mushroom.lore: No monsters spawn in mushroom fields. Maybe the safest place in the world.
survivalassistant.muse.lush_caves.build: A hidden garden room down here, with glow berries as lamps. Wouldn't that be magical?
survivalassistant.muse.lush_caves.scene: Moss, vines and glow berries. Who knew a cave could be this pretty?
survivalassistant.muse.lush_caves.lore: Axolotls live in the pools down here. They're great friends underwater.
survivalassistant.muse.dripstone.build: A great hall carved out between these dripstone columns would look amazing.
survivalassistant.muse.dripstone.scene: Drip, drip... water slowly building those stone spikes. Mind your head.
survivalassistant.muse.dripstone.lore: Put a cauldron under dripping dripstone and it slowly fills with water.
survivalassistant.muse.sulfur_caves.buil: These yellow rocks would make a striking wall for a hideout.
survivalassistant.muse.sulfur_caves.scen: That smell... sulfur. Let's stay alert down here.
survivalassistant.muse.sulfur_caves.lore: Strange place, isn't it? What do you think made these caves?
survivalassistant.muse.deep_dark.scene: ...I'll whisper down here. Let's look around quietly, and leave.
survivalassistant.muse.deep_dark.lore: ...Ancient cities sleep down here. Let's not wake what guards them.
survivalassistant.muse.nether.scene: It's so hot here. Keep your eyes open and your shield ready.
survivalassistant.muse.nether.lore: Piglins love gold. Wearing one piece of gold armor keeps them calm.
survivalassistant.muse.end.scene: The End... so quiet and strange. Mind the void below.
survivalassistant.muse.end.lore: Endermen are everywhere here. Whatever you do, don't look them in the eye.
survivalassistant.muse.other.scene: I don't know this place. Let's explore it carefully.
survivalassistant.muse.other.lore: Every new place has a story. I wonder what this one's is.
survivalassistant.muse.mob.cow: Look at those cows, so peaceful. A bucket of their milk even clears bad effects.
survivalassistant.muse.mob.sheep: Those sheep eat grass to grow their wool back after shearing. Clever animals.
survivalassistant.muse.mob.pig: A pig with a saddle can be ridden. You steer it with a carrot on a stick!
survivalassistant.muse.mob.chicken: Chickens lay an egg every few minutes. Throw one and sometimes a chick hatches!
survivalassistant.muse.mob.horse: Horses! Keep climbing on one until hearts appear, then a saddle lets you ride it.
survivalassistant.muse.mob.fox: A fox! They sleep during the day, and sometimes carry an item in their mouth.
survivalassistant.muse.mob.wolf: Wild wolves stay calm unless you hit one. With bones you could make a loyal friend.
survivalassistant.muse.mob.rabbit: Rabbits love carrots. They'll even sneak into a carrot farm for a snack.
survivalassistant.muse.mob.parrot: Parrots can sit on your shoulder once you tame them with seeds. Never feed them cookies!
survivalassistant.muse.mob.bee: Bees pollinate flowers and help crops grow. Leave their nest alone unless there's a campfire under it.
survivalassistant.muse.mob.frog: Frogs come in three colors, depending on the climate their tadpole grew up in.
survivalassistant.muse.mob.turtle: Turtles always return to the beach where they hatched to lay their eggs.
survivalassistant.muse.mob.camel: A camel carries two riders and can dash over gaps. Perfect for desert trips.
survivalassistant.muse.mob.goat: Goats jump really high, and they can ram you off a ledge. Keep an eye on them!
survivalassistant.muse.mob.axolotl: Axolotls play dead when they're hurt, and they help you fight underwater.
survivalassistant.muse.mob.llama: Llamas spit when they're angry, and a group of them can carry chests for you.
survivalassistant.muse.mob.panda: Every panda has its own personality: lazy, playful, worried... some even sneeze!
survivalassistant.about.1: I've seen more worlds than I can count, but I'll never forget my very first night.
survivalassistant.about.2: My first night I got lost and hid in a hole in the ground with one torch. That's why I help newcomers now.
survivalassistant.about.3: I collect maps. Well... I collect them, and then I lose them.
survivalassistant.about.4: Creepers? Brr. That hissing still makes me jump, after all these years.
survivalassistant.about.5: Nothing beats a sunrise after a long night. That's when I know we made it.
survivalassistant.about.6: Deep underground I once saw a Warden in the distance. I've never sneaked away so quietly.
survivalassistant.about.7: My own house? Never finished it. There was always another hill to look behind.
survivalassistant.about.8: Rain on the roof, a fox in the grass, fresh bread... that's all I need. Oh, and no deep water, please.
survivalassistant.cmd.name_invalid: Choose a name of at most %s letters, digits or spaces.
survivalassistant.light.on: Light check on: red dots = monsters can spawn there. Place torches until they're gone.
survivalassistant.light.no_effect: Light check: in this dimension light doesn't stop monsters from spawning.
survivalassistant.light.all_lit: Light check: everything nearby is lit. No monsters can spawn here.
survivalassistant.step.iron_golem.iron_b: A golem needs 4 iron blocks. Each block is 9 iron ingots.
survivalassistant.step.iron_golem.pumpki: Place a pumpkin and use shears on it to carve a face. Then mine it.
Stack the iron blocks in a T: two on top of each other, one left and right of the top one. Put the carved pumpkin on last.
survivalassistant.step.enter_nether.obsi: A portal frame takes 10 obsidian, 14 with the corners. Mine it with a diamond pickaxe, or pour water on still lava.
survivalassistant.step.enter_nether.ligh: Build an upright frame, 4 wide and 5 high and hollow inside, and light the inside with flint and steel.
survivalassistant.step.enter_nether.step: Stand in the purple portal for a few seconds. Bring food, blocks and your golden armor.
survivalassistant.step.brew_potion.bottl: Make glass bottles: 3 glass in a V shape gives 3 bottles. Glass is sand smelted in a furnace.
survivalassistant.step.brew_potion.water: Use the bottles on water to fill them. Water bottles are the base of every potion.
Craft a blaze rod into 2 blaze powder and put one in the left slot of the brewing stand: that's its fuel.
Water bottles in the bottom slots, Nether wart on top: that makes an awkward potion. Then add an ingredient, like sugar for swiftness.
survivalassistant.step.bookshelves.paper: Paper comes from sugar cane: 3 cane in a row gives 3 paper. One bookshelf needs 9 paper.
survivalassistant.step.bookshelves.leath: Cows drop leather. One bookshelf needs 3 books, and every book takes 1 leather.
survivalassistant.step.bookshelves.books: A book is 3 paper and 1 leather, anywhere in the crafting grid.
survivalassistant.step.bookshelves.craft: A bookshelf: 3 books in the middle row, planks above and below.
survivalassistant.step.bookshelves.place: Place the bookshelf two blocks from the enchanting table, at the same height or one higher, with air in between.
survivalassistant.step.eyes_of_ender.pow: Every eye needs blaze powder. One blaze rod gives 2 powder.
survivalassistant.step.eyes_of_ender.cra: An eye of ender is an ender pearl and blaze powder, anywhere in the crafting grid.
survivalassistant.step.find_stronghold.t: Throw an eye of ender into the air: it flies towards the stronghold. Walk after it.
survivalassistant.step.find_stronghold.f: Keep throwing eyes. When one sinks into the ground, the stronghold is below you: dig down like a staircase.
survivalassistant.step.dragon.crystals.t: Shoot the end crystals on top of the pillars with arrows: they heal the dragon. For caged ones you have to climb up.
survivalassistant.step.dragon.fight.tip: Hit the dragon when it lands on the portal in the middle, and use arrows while it flies. Stay out of its purple breath.
survivalassistant.step.netherite_ingot.d: You need 4 ancient debris. It lies deep in the Nether, most of it around Y 15.
survivalassistant.step.netherite_ingot.s: Smelt the ancient debris in a furnace: each one gives a piece of netherite scrap.
survivalassistant.step.netherite_ingot.g: You also need 4 gold ingots. Nether gold ore and bastions are good places for gold.
survivalassistant.step.netherite_ingot.c: Put 4 netherite scrap and 4 gold ingots anywhere in the crafting grid: that's one netherite ingot.
survivalassistant.step.beacon.glass.tip: A beacon needs 5 glass. Smelt sand in a furnace.
survivalassistant.step.beacon.obsidian.t: And 3 obsidian for the bottom row of the recipe.
survivalassistant.step.beacon.craft.tip: Glass around the nether star and 3 obsidian at the bottom: that's a beacon.
survivalassistant.step.beacon.base.tip: Place the beacon on a 3x3 square of iron, gold, emerald or diamond blocks, with open sky above it.
survivalassistant.step.full_beacon.level: Under the 3x3, lay a 5x5 layer of mineral blocks: 25 more.
Then a 7x7 layer under that: 49 blocks.
The last layer is 9x9: 81 blocks. Then you can pick the strongest powers.
survivalassistant.step.auto_smelter.hopp: You need 2 hoppers. Each one is 5 iron ingots around a chest.
Sneak and place a hopper on top of the furnace: whatever you put in falls into the furnace.
survivalassistant.step.auto_smelter.bott: Put a hopper under the furnace that leads into a chest: smelted items end up there. Fuel goes in from the side.
The table needs 2 diamonds. Your pickaxe used 3, so you may have to mine a few more. The environment card shows the best height.
And 4 obsidian: one in the middle and three in the bottom row.
The table needs a book, and a book takes 3 paper. Paper is 3 sugar cane in a row.
Cows drop leather. The book needs 1.
Put 3 paper and 1 leather anywhere in the crafting grid: that's a book.
Book on top, a diamond left and right of the middle, obsidian in the middle and in the bottom row.
survivalassistant.step.treasure.map.tip: Open the chests in shipwrecks and ocean ruins: they can hold a treasure map with a red X.
survivalassistant.step.treasure.follow.t: Hold the map and walk until your marker reaches the red X. Treasure lies on beaches and under the sea floor.
survivalassistant.step.treasure.dig.tip: Dig straight down at the X: the chest is usually a few blocks under the sand. The heart of the sea is inside.
survivalassistant.step.harness.leather.t: A harness takes 3 leather. Cows, horses and llamas drop it.
survivalassistant.step.harness.glass.tip: And 2 glass: smelt sand in a furnace.
survivalassistant.step.harness.wool.tip: And 1 wool. Its color becomes the color of the harness.
survivalassistant.step.harness.craft.tip: 3 leather on top, with glass, wool and glass below it: that's a harness.
survivalassistant.step.honey.bottle.tip: You collect honey with a glass bottle: 3 glass in a V shape gives 3 bottles.
survivalassistant.step.honey.hive.tip: Bee nests hang under the leaves of trees, mostly in plains, meadows and flower forests. Follow the bees.
survivalassistant.step.honey.campfire.ti: Place a campfire at most 5 blocks under the nest. The smoke keeps the bees calm, so they won't attack you.
survivalassistant.step.honey.wait.tip: Wait until the nest is full: honey drips from it. Bees fill it after visiting flowers.
survivalassistant.step.honey.collect.tip: Use the glass bottle on the full nest: that gives a honey bottle.
survivalassistant.step.horse.find.tip: Horses, donkeys and mules live on plains and savannas. Walk up close to one.
survivalassistant.step.horse.tame.tip: Get on it with an empty hand. It throws you off at first: keep trying until hearts appear.
survivalassistant.step.horse.saddle.tip: To steer a horse you need a saddle: 3 leather and 1 iron ingot. You can also find one in chests.
survivalassistant.step.horse.ride.tip: Open the horse's inventory while riding it and put the saddle in its slot. Now you can steer it.
survivalassistant.step.find_fortress.net: Fortresses are only in the Nether. Go back through your portal.
survivalassistant.step.find_fortress.sea: Explore in one direction and look for long bridges of dark red bricks. Now and then build a small pillar with a torch, so you can find your way back.
survivalassistant.step.find_fortress.ent: A fortress is close by! Look around for the dark red bricks and walk onto its bridges.
survivalassistant.step.blaze_rods.nether: Blazes live only in Nether fortresses. Go back through your portal.
survivalassistant.step.blaze_rods.find.t: In the fortress, blazes float around a small cage with flames inside. Listen for their crackling breath.
Blazes are close! Wait behind a wall, hit them when they come near and grab the rods. Snowballs hurt them too.
survivalassistant.step.nether_wart.nethe: Nether wart grows in the Nether, mostly in fortresses. Go back through your portal.
Look in the fortress for small red plants on soul sand, often next to the stairs.
Break the big, dark red plants: grown wart gives 2 to 4. Keep a few to plant at home on soul sand.
survivalassistant.step.respawn_anchor.cr: Crying obsidian is purple obsidian with tears. Piglins sometimes give it for gold, and ruined portals and bastions have it.
survivalassistant.step.respawn_anchor.gl: Glowstone hangs from the Nether's ceiling. Breaking it gives dust: 4 dust make 1 block.
survivalassistant.step.respawn_anchor.cr: Crying obsidian in the top and bottom rows, the 3 glowstone in the middle row.
survivalassistant.step.respawn_anchor.pl: Put the anchor down in the Nether, for example near your portal. In the overworld it explodes when you use it.
survivalassistant.step.respawn_anchor.ch: Right-click the anchor with glowstone blocks until it is full: 4 charges.
survivalassistant.step.summon_wither.spo: The Wither breaks blocks all around it. Go deep underground or into the Nether, far from home.
survivalassistant.step.summon_wither.bas: Place 1 soul sand, then 3 in a row on top of it: a T. Keep the space above the top row free.
survivalassistant.step.summon_wither.sku: Put the 3 skulls on the top row. The last one wakes the Wither: step back at once, it explodes as it wakes.
survivalassistant.step.trident.drowned.t: Drowned are zombies that live in rivers and oceans. They come out in the dark, so search the water at night.
survivalassistant.step.trident.armed.tip: Look for a drowned that holds a trident. Most don't have one, so keep looking.
survivalassistant.step.trident.fight.tip: This one has a trident! Lure it to the shore and fight it there. It doesn't always drop the trident, so try more of them.
Echo shards lie in the chests of ancient cities. Sneak, and open the chests quietly.
A compass is 4 iron ingots around a redstone dust.
Put the compass in the middle of the crafting grid and the 8 echo shards around it.
survivalassistant.step.mace.rod.tip: Breezes in the trial chambers drop breeze rods. Fight them up close: they deflect arrows.
survivalassistant.step.mace.core.tip: The heavy core is rare loot from ominous vaults. Keep beating ominous trials until you find it.
survivalassistant.step.mace.craft.tip: Put the heavy core in the crafting grid with the breeze rod right below it.
survivalassistant.step.turtle_helmet.tur: Turtles live on warm sandy beaches. Look along the coast for small green turtles.
survivalassistant.step.turtle_helmet.sea: Turtles eat seagrass. It grows on the sea floor: cut it with shears, otherwise you get nothing.
survivalassistant.step.turtle_helmet.egg: Feed two turtles seagrass. One swims to its home beach and lays eggs in the sand.
survivalassistant.step.turtle_helmet.scu: The eggs hatch faster at night. Guard them from zombies, and don't step on them. Every baby drops a scute as it grows up.
survivalassistant.step.turtle_helmet.cra: Put the 5 scutes in the crafting grid like a helmet: 3 on top, 1 on each side below.
survivalassistant.step.dried_ghast.nethe: Ghasts float in the Nether, mostly over lava and in soul sand valleys. Go back through your portal.
survivalassistant.step.dried_ghast.tears: A ghast drops a tear when it dies. Shoot it with arrows, or hit its fireballs back at it. Or look for a dried ghast in a fossil.
survivalassistant.step.dried_ghast.soul_: You need 1 soul sand for the middle. It lies in soul sand valleys in the Nether.
survivalassistant.step.dried_ghast.craft: Put the soul sand in the middle of the crafting grid and the 8 ghast tears around it.
survivalassistant.step.copper_bulb.coppe: Copper ore lies in hills and under the sea. 9 copper ingots make a block.
survivalassistant.step.copper_bulb.blaze: The bulb needs a blaze rod in the middle. Blazes live in Nether fortresses.
survivalassistant.step.copper_bulb.redst: One redstone dust goes at the bottom. Mine redstone ore deep underground.
survivalassistant.step.copper_bulb.craft: Copper blocks at the top and on both sides, the blaze rod in the middle, the redstone below it. You get 4 bulbs.
survivalassistant.step.copper_bulb.place: Put a copper bulb down where you want light, for example next to a wall.
survivalassistant.step.copper_bulb.pulse: Put a button or a lever next to the bulb and use it. Each pulse switches the bulb: on, then off.
Bastions are only in the Nether. Go back through your portal.
Explore and look for huge, dark buildings of blackstone. Watch them from a safe spot first.
A bastion is close! The template is in a chest, almost always in the treasure room. Opening chests makes piglins angry, so be ready.
survivalassistant.step.crafter_crafts.cr: First put a crafter down: 5 iron ingots, a crafting table, 2 redstone and a dropper.
survivalassistant.step.crafter_crafts.ir: The new crafter needs 5 iron ingots. Smelt iron ore in a furnace.
survivalassistant.step.crafter_crafts.pa: Also needed: a dropper (7 cobblestone around a redstone), a crafting table and 2 redstone.
survivalassistant.step.crafter_crafts.fi: Open the crafter and lay out the recipe: iron along the top and sides, the crafting table in the middle, redstone, dropper, redstone at the bottom.
survivalassistant.step.crafter_crafts.pu: Press a button next to the crafter. It drops the new crafter out of its front.
survivalassistant.step.farm.hoe.tip: A hoe is 2 planks and 2 sticks. Any kind of hoe works.
survivalassistant.step.farm.seeds.tip: Break tall grass for wheat seeds. Carrots and potatoes from villages work too.
survivalassistant.step.farm.till.tip: Right-click dirt or grass with the hoe, within 4 blocks of water. No water? Dig a hole and pour some in.
survivalassistant.step.farm.plant.tip: Right-click the tilled soil with your seeds. Don't jump on it: that turns it back into dirt.
survivalassistant.step.bow.string.tip: Spiders drop string; they come out at night. Cobwebs in mineshafts give string too.
survivalassistant.step.bow.craft.tip: 3 sticks and 3 string make a bow.
survivalassistant.step.bow.flint.tip: Break gravel: now and then it drops flint. Each flint makes 4 arrows.
survivalassistant.step.bow.feathers.tip: Chickens drop feathers. Each feather makes 4 arrows.
survivalassistant.step.bow.arrows.tip: Flint on top, a stick in the middle, a feather below: 4 arrows. Make 16.
survivalassistant.step.bread.ripe.tip: Wheat is ripe when it is tall and yellow-brown. Bone meal makes it grow faster.
survivalassistant.step.bread.harvest.tip: Break the ripe wheat: each plant gives 1 wheat and some seeds. Plant the seeds again.
survivalassistant.step.bread.bake.tip: Put 3 wheat in a row on the crafting table. Make 3 breads.
Wolves live in forests and taigas, cats in villages.
A wolf wants bones, which skeletons drop. A cat wants raw cod or salmon: go fishing.
Hold the food and right-click the animal until hearts appear. Move slowly near a cat, or it runs away.
survivalassistant.step.milk.iron.tip: A bucket takes 3 iron ingots. Smelt iron ore in a furnace.
survivalassistant.step.milk.bucket.tip: Put the 3 iron ingots in a V shape on the crafting table.
survivalassistant.step.milk.cow.tip: Cows live on grassy plains. Mooshrooms and goats give milk too.
survivalassistant.step.milk.milk.tip: Hold the empty bucket and right-click the cow.
survivalassistant.step.fishing.string.ti: Spiders drop string; they come out at night. Cobwebs give string too.
survivalassistant.step.fishing.rod.tip: 3 sticks on a diagonal, 2 string hanging down the right side.
survivalassistant.step.fishing.water.tip: Any water works, even a small pond. Stand at the edge.
survivalassistant.step.fishing.cast.tip: Right-click to cast. When the bobber dips under, right-click again to reel in.
survivalassistant.step.full_iron_armor.h: A helmet takes 5 iron ingots: 3 across the top, 1 under each end.
survivalassistant.step.full_iron_armor.c: A chestplate takes 8 iron ingots: every square except the top middle.
survivalassistant.step.full_iron_armor.l: Leggings take 7 iron ingots: an upside-down U.
survivalassistant.step.full_iron_armor.b: Boots take 4 iron ingots: 2 on each side, in the two lower rows.
survivalassistant.step.diamond_pickaxe.i: Diamond ore only drops diamonds when you mine it with an iron pickaxe: 3 iron ingots and 2 sticks.
survivalassistant.step.diamond_pickaxe.d: Diamonds lie deep down, most of them around Y -59. Press F3 to see your height. Dig a staircase, never straight down.
Diamond ore is stone with light-blue spots. Dig long tunnels and watch out for lava.
survivalassistant.step.diamond_pickaxe.c: 3 diamonds across the top, 2 sticks down the middle.
survivalassistant.step.enchant.table.tip: Place your enchanting table. Bookshelves around it give stronger enchantments.
survivalassistant.step.enchant.lapis.tip: Lapis lazuli is a blue ore deep underground. Each enchantment costs 1 to 3.
survivalassistant.step.enchant.levels.ti: You gain levels by mining ore, smelting and defeating mobs. Each enchantment costs 1 to 3 levels.
survivalassistant.step.enchant.enchant.t: Put a tool, weapon or armor in the table, add lapis and pick an option. The bottom one is the strongest.
survivalassistant.recipe.title: Recipe: %s
survivalassistant.mob.creeper: explodes about 1.5 s after it starts hissing. Back off, hit it and back off again.
survivalassistant.mob.zombie: slow, burns in sunlight. A good first fight with a sword.
survivalassistant.mob.zombie_villager: fights like a zombie. Later you can cure it: splash potion of weakness, then a golden apple.
survivalassistant.mob.husk: desert zombie that does NOT burn in the sun. Its hit makes you hungry.
survivalassistant.mob.drowned: lives in water, some throw tridents. Stay out of deep water at night.
survivalassistant.mob.skeleton: shoots arrows, burns in sunlight. Use cover or a shield and close in fast.
survivalassistant.mob.stray: snow skeleton: its arrows slow you down.
survivalassistant.mob.bogged: swamp skeleton: its arrows poison you.
survivalassistant.mob.parched: desert skeleton: its arrows weaken you, so you deal less damage.
survivalassistant.mob.spider: climbs walls. In daylight it leaves you alone unless you hit it. Drops string.
survivalassistant.mob.cave_spider: small and poisonous, found in mineshafts. Block its spawner with torches.
survivalassistant.mob.enderman: don't look at its eyes. Hide under a 2-block-high roof or stand in water.
survivalassistant.mob.witch: throws harmful potions and heals itself. Avoid it early on.
survivalassistant.mob.slime: splits into smaller slimes when hit. The smallest ones are harmless.
survivalassistant.mob.phantom: comes when you haven't slept for 3 nights. Sleep in a bed to stop them.
survivalassistant.mob.pillager: shoots a crossbow and travels in groups. Avoid them early on.
survivalassistant.mob.silverfish: hides in stone. When hit, it wakes up other silverfish nearby. Finish it fast.
survivalassistant.mob.creaking: can't be hurt and only moves when you look away. Break its creaking heart.
survivalassistant.mob.sheep: wool for a bed. Shears give 1-3 wool, killing gives 1.
survivalassistant.mob.cow: beef and leather. Milk (bucket) removes bad effects.
survivalassistant.mob.pig: drops porkchops: cook them in a furnace for good food.
survivalassistant.mob.chicken: feathers for arrows, eggs, and chicken meat (cook it first).
survivalassistant.mob.wolf: tame it with bones and it will fight for you.
survivalassistant.tip.dig_down.1: Stop! You're digging straight down. You could fall into lava or a deep cave. Dig like a staircase instead.
survivalassistant.tip.dig_down.2: Never dig the block under your own feet. Mine one block ahead and one down, step by step.
survivalassistant.tip.lava_near.1: Careful, there's lava very close! Don't mine towards it; put a block in between.
survivalassistant.tip.lava_near.2: Lava nearby! Move slowly (sneak) and keep a water bucket or blocks ready.
survivalassistant.tip.phantoms.1: You haven't slept for two nights. After the third night phantoms come for you from the sky. Sleep in a bed!
survivalassistant.tip.phantoms.2: Tired? Sleep tonight: without sleep, flying phantoms appear after three nights.
survivalassistant.tip.falling_block.1: Watch out: there's sand or gravel right above your head. It falls when you mine below it.
survivalassistant.nav.death_other: Your items: in the %s, max %s left

survivalassistant.settings.world.unavail: The server's settings could not be read.
survivalassistant.cmd.character_on: The guide character is back. Use /guide character off to hide it again.
