survivalassistant.cmd.npc_off_recall: The guide character is off. Turn it on with /guide character on.
survivalassistant.welcome_no_npc: Your task list is in the corner of the screen (J switches the view, K shows or hides the environment card). I'll only speak up when there's danger.

survivalassistant.settings.discard.title: Discard your changes?
survivalassistant.settings.discard.messa: You changed settings without saving them.

survivalassistant.settings.advanced.tip: Small talk through a local language model. Only useful when a model server is running.
survivalassistant.settings.mode.tip: Compact shows the current task, full shows all goals of the chapter. Switch with J.
survivalassistant.settings.corner.tip: The screen corner of the task card; the environment card sits below it.
survivalassistant.settings.scale.tip: Size of the cards, on top of the game's GUI scale.
survivalassistant.settings.margin.tip: Space between the cards and the edge of the screen.
survivalassistant.settings.show_steps.ti: Shows the next small step under a big task, like filling bottles before brewing.
survivalassistant.settings.show_environm: The biome, the best height for ores and nearby dangers. Switch with K.
survivalassistant.settings.env_lines.tip: Full adds the biome's pros and cons and the hazards; compact keeps the header and the ores.
survivalassistant.settings.recipe_card.t: Shows the recipe for your current task next to the inventory and the crafting table.
survivalassistant.settings.crosshair_inf: Info about the mob or ore you look at: a tip for mobs, the right pickaxe for ores.
survivalassistant.settings.crosshair_pla: Under the crosshair, or in a card under the environment card that stays 2 seconds after you look away.
survivalassistant.settings.crosshair_ran: How far away a mob gets info, so you can read about a creeper before it hisses. Ores keep the normal reach.
survivalassistant.settings.skin.tip: Your own skins go in the skin folder (64x64 PNG). Only you see the change.
survivalassistant.settings.skin_folder.t: Opens the folder for your own guide skins.
survivalassistant.settings.keys.tip: Change the keys for the task card (J), the environment card (K), the light check (L) and this screen.
survivalassistant.settings.character.tip: The guide walks along with you. Off: the tips come in chat only.
survivalassistant.settings.musings.tip: Remarks about the biome and the animals around you. Everywhere: also in the Nether, the End and the Deep Dark.
survivalassistant.settings.name: Name
survivalassistant.settings.name.tip: Your own name for the guide. Leave it empty for the server's name.
survivalassistant.settings.chat.tip: Chat with the guide through a language model, when the server allows it.
survivalassistant.settings.more_chapters: After chapter 1, offer the next chapters, up to the ender dragon and beyond.
survivalassistant.settings.spawn_on_join: A guide appears by itself for players who join for the first time.
Players can bring back a guide that has left with /guide call.
survivalassistant.settings.npc_default.t: Whether the guide walks along as a character, unless a player chooses otherwise.
The name every guide gets, unless a player chooses their own.
How often the guide looks at your situation. The pauses below prevent too many tips.
survivalassistant.settings.milestone_coo: Minimum time between two tips about your goals.
survivalassistant.settings.urgent_cooldo: Minimum time before the same warning comes again.
survivalassistant.settings.depth_notices: A one-time note when you reach deepslate, lava level, the Deep Dark or high mountains.
survivalassistant.settings.point_at_reso: The guide looks at nearby trees or stone when it gives those tips.
survivalassistant.settings.navigation.ti: Shows the way back to your items after dying, and the way home.
survivalassistant.settings.home_distance: Show the way home from this distance. At dusk and at night already from 24 blocks.
survivalassistant.settings.musings_defau: Let the guide muse about the biome and the animals. Players can switch it off for themselves.
survivalassistant.settings.musings_dange: Also muse in the Nether, the End and the Deep Dark. Players can choose Everywhere themselves.
Allow small talk through the language model on this server. Players can switch it off for themselves. Needs a running model server.
survivalassistant.settings.chat_spontane: The guide remarks on changes by itself: the weather, the time of day, a new biome or mob.
survivalassistant.settings.chat_endpoint: The chat completions address of the model server, for example llama-server.
survivalassistant.settings.chat_model.ti: Model name sent along. llama-server ignores it, other servers may need it.
survivalassistant.settings.chat_cooldown: Minimum time between two spontaneous remarks.
The guide reacts to chat from players within this distance.
survivalassistant.settings.chat_sight.ti: Mobs within this distance and in sight count as nearby in the conversation.
survivalassistant.settings.chat_max_toke: Maximum length of a reply, in tokens.
survivalassistant.settings.chat_temperat: Higher is more playful, lower more predictable. Server: the model server's own setting.
Stop waiting for an answer after this time.
How many exchanges the guide remembers within a session.
survivalassistant.env.pointer.mountain: %s: lots of it at this height (mountains)
survivalassistant.depth.deepslate: You've reached deepslate (below Y 0). Diamonds start below Y 16 and are most common around Y -59. Mining is slower here.
survivalassistant.depth.lava: Careful: below Y -54 caves fill with lava lakes. Keep a water bucket and blocks at hand.
survivalassistant.depth.deep_dark: This is the deep dark. Sneak, don't trigger the sculk shriekers, or the warden will come!
survivalassistant.depth.high_iron: High up in the mountains there's extra iron (and emerald ore) in the stone. Great for your iron gear!
survivalassistant.biome.plains.pro: All farm animals and flat land to build on
survivalassistant.biome.plains.con: Few trees and little cover: build a shelter in time
survivalassistant.biome.forest.pro: Lots of wood, apples and all farm animals
survivalassistant.biome.forest.con: Under leaves, monsters don't burn by day
survivalassistant.biome.birch_forest.pro: Light forest: plenty of wood and farm animals
survivalassistant.biome.birch_forest.con: No oaks, so no apples from the leaves
survivalassistant.biome.dark_forest.pro: Huge dark oaks: loads of wood and apples
survivalassistant.biome.dark_forest.con: So dark that monsters can spawn by day
survivalassistant.biome.pale_garden.pro: Pale oak wood and resin from creaking hearts
survivalassistant.biome.pale_garden.con: No animals to eat; creaking at night
survivalassistant.biome.dappled_forest.p: All farm animals and brown mushrooms
survivalassistant.biome.dappled_forest.c: Ordinary forest dangers: stay inside at night
survivalassistant.biome.taiga.pro: Spruce wood, sweet berries and all farm animals
survivalassistant.biome.taiga.con: Sweet berry bushes hurt when you walk through
survivalassistant.biome.snowy.pro: Snow and ice to build with; rabbits to hunt
survivalassistant.biome.snowy.con: Little food, and strays shoot slowing arrows
survivalassistant.biome.mountains.pro: Lots of iron high up and emerald ore
survivalassistant.biome.mountains.con: Steep drops, ramming goats, powder snow
survivalassistant.biome.meadow.pro: Sheep for wool, flowers, and emerald ore
survivalassistant.biome.meadow.con: High up and open: mind the edges at night
survivalassistant.biome.desert.pro: Sand for glass, cactus, temples and villages
survivalassistant.biome.desert.con: Only rabbits and camels; husks make you hungry
survivalassistant.biome.savanna.pro: Acacia wood, farm animals, horses and villages
survivalassistant.biome.savanna.con: Open land with little cover at night
survivalassistant.biome.jungle.pro: Melons, cocoa beans, bamboo and lots of wood
survivalassistant.biome.jungle.con: Dense and confusing: you get lost easily
survivalassistant.biome.swamp.con: Witches, and bogged that shoot poison arrows
survivalassistant.biome.shore.pro: Sugar cane for paper and sand for glass
survivalassistant.biome.shore.con: Drowned can come out of rivers at night
survivalassistant.biome.ocean.pro: Shipwrecks and ruins with loot; fish to eat
survivalassistant.biome.ocean.con: Drowned with tridents; watch your air bubbles
survivalassistant.biome.mushroom.pro: No monsters spawn here; mooshrooms give stew
survivalassistant.biome.mushroom.con: No trees: bring your own wood
survivalassistant.biome.lush_caves.pro: Glow berries to eat, axolotls and clay
survivalassistant.biome.lush_caves.con: Still a cave: monsters spawn in the dark
survivalassistant.biome.dripstone.con: Falling dripstone hurts; drowned in pools
survivalassistant.biome.deep_dark.pro: Ancient cities with great loot; no normal mob spawns
survivalassistant.biome.deep_dark.con: The warden: sneak and avoid sculk shriekers
survivalassistant.biome.sulfur_caves.pro: Sulfur pools, springs and spikes to discover
survivalassistant.biome.sulfur_caves.con: Sulfur cubes spawn here, plus creepers and skeletons
survivalassistant.biome.nether.con: No water, lots of lava: not for your first days
survivalassistant.biome.end.pro: The end of the game: the dragon and End cities
survivalassistant.biome.end.con: Endermen everywhere; only go with good gear
survivalassistant.biome.other.pro: Look around for wood, food and stone
